title: The Portrait of the Fens
author: Ulyana Sterling
blurb: Oscar Kavanagh, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the statute expires.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
